display_long_description:
Step into the **Cozy Worlds Demo** and get a taste of a unique world-building experience. Sculpt floating terrain with a wave of your hand, grow vibrant plants, and watch your imagination take shape - no art experience required.

In the demo, restore your very first Grove in World-Builder Mode, try the intuitive toolkit, and unlock a small selection of decorations from the full Creative Library. A gentle introduction to help you breathe, explore, and see what Cozy Worlds is all about.

The best part? It’s only the beginning.

✨ Upgrade to the full version to unlock the complete Cozy Worlds experience✨ 

**A growing world-building journey**

Gain access to a steady stream of new Worlds, each one a new “level” filled with plants, structures, tools, and surprises you can carry into Creative Mode forever. Cozy Worlds is still expanding - and your Creative Library grows with every update!

[media]

**Full Creative Mode**

Build freely with no limits, no restrictions, and every unlocked item at your fingertips

[media]


**Expanding Creative Library**

Unlock 40+ plants, stones, structures, and natural elements: Fill your Worlds with vibrant life, cozy details, and atmospheric touches. Gain elements in your library by completing Worlds in World-Builder Mode
[media]

**Toolkit to Cultivate Your World**

Paint & erase terrain, interact with living elements, and customize your creations using your intuitive toolkit. 
[media]

Explore the full version and start your creative journey in Cozy Worlds! 
Available exclusively for Meta Quest 3 & 3S
